'''Tyler Vastag''' played the [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]], [[2009 Bespin Regionals]]. With Brian Herold he was a contact for the [[2005 North Dakota State Championship]] in Fargo on 25 June 2005;<ref name="pcf-5018-68750">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=68750#68750 ND States: June 25 - Ulimate Package Up For Grabs], Brian Herold (thepityofmrt), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 April 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050830064902/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=72922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> posting as tvas27, he wrote that it had been "incredibly difficult" to find a weekend that suited most players, and that he hoped to top the previous year's 32 players.<ref name="pcf-5018-70833">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=70833#70833 ND States: June 25 - Ulimate Package Up For Grabs], Tyler Vastag (tvas27), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 April 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050830064902/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=72922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He announced the [[2006 North Dakota State Championship]] on 8 July 2006 at Paradox Cards & Comics in Fargo and was its tournament director.<ref name="sf-10491-143421">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=143421#p143421 ND States Championship], Tyler Vastag (tvas27), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 June 2006).</ref> At the [[2008 Bespin Regionals]] on 26 July 2008 he and [[Jim Li]] earned Day 2 bids for the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], Cedric (simone89), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref> He was the main tournament director of the [[2009 North Dakota State Championship]] on 9 May 2009 at Paradox Comics-N-Cards in Fargo, using the three-judge system that let the tournament director play,<ref name="sf-25847-381867">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=381867#p381867 2009 ND States], Brian Herold (The Smoking Gungan), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 February 2009).</ref> and finished 15th after dropping after two games.<ref name="sf-25847-414386">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=414386#p414386 2009 ND States], Brian Herold (The Smoking Gungan), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 May 2009).</ref>

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 2 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Tyler Vastag (2 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Block 1]] and [[Virtual Block 2]], sets dated 2009 on this wiki. The events named in the concept credits date from 2006. The concept credits also name the event or award the concept came from: Twin Cities V-Lite 2006 (1 card); Bespin Regionals 2006 (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Tyler Vastag|Card Credits]].
